analysis_unit: translation of the single-active initial condition on the fixed directed cycle

development.access: allowed only after the development run seal passes

held_out.release_condition: independent implementation, frozen candidate, frozen hashes, and a new confirmatory protocol

expected_invariance: every translation must give the exactly translated trajectory and identical detector result
interpretation_limit: the reserved offsets are algebraically implied by exact cycle-translation equivariance; the split is implementation bookkeeping only and cannot provide confirmation or statistical generalization
future_generality_requirement: define a population of initial conditions or topologies plus a worst-case or pass-rate estimand before making a generalization claim
